messages.content: Explain in exactly three sentences why floating-point addition is not associative.
Explain in exactly three sentences why floating-point addition is not associative.

samples.text: Floating-point addition is not associative because the order in which you add numbers can affect the result due to the way floating-point numbers are represented and stored in computer memory. This is because the addition of floating-point numbers involves a combination of integer arithmetic and rounding, which can lead to different results depending on the order of operations. For example, the sum of a and b can be different from the sum of b and a, even if a and b are the same numbers.
